comparison.objective: Send a corded blender through a service lift without trapping its cord; the candidate sets a gripper stop.
comparison.physical_skill: Appliance placement, flexible-cord routing, and door/lift coordination, not screw-and-jam-nut adjustment.
comparison.success_condition: Blender is transferred while its cord remains untrapped and undamaged; candidate tests retained mechanical calibration.
comparison.reason: All available versions concern cord-safe transfer, not coupled threaded locking.
